Tampa Published Development Records / Snapshot change dashboard

Comparison 2026-10-01 to 2026-11-01

← Dashboard index

This dashboard describes changes in records returned by published sources. A disappearance does not prove cancellation or deletion, a new record does not prove newly started work, and a phase change does not prove completed construction.

CRITICAL 2026-10-01 → 2026-11-01

31 days; manual_interval; canonical monthly comparison: no.

  • CRITICAL critical_disappearance_rate — capital_improvements: Most earlier records were no longer returned. This does not prove deletion or cancellation.
  • CRITICAL source_count_collapse — capital_improvements: Published source count collapsed relative to the earlier observation; investigate source filters or availability.
  • WARNING high_publication_churn — capital_improvements: A large share of the source union entered or left the published result.
  • WARNING high_publication_churn — development_coordination: A large share of the source union entered or left the published result.
  • WARNING high_publication_churn — historic_preservation: A large share of the source union entered or left the published result.
  • WARNING mass_field_refresh — historic_preservation: Field CREATEDDATE changed across most retained records, suggesting a systematic refresh.
  • WARNING mass_field_refresh — single_family_permits: Field CREATEDDATE changed across most retained records, suggesting a systematic refresh.
  • WARNING noncanonical_interval: This interval is a baseline follow-up or manual observation, not a canonical month-end trend point.
  • INFORMATIONAL notable_source_net_change — capital_locations_point: Source count moved beyond the informational threshold.

This dashboard describes changes in records returned by published sources. A disappearance does not prove cancellation or deletion, a new record does not prove newly started work, and a phase change does not prove completed construction.
